# GHENO

> Landing page and B2B lead-generation site for GHENO high-performance MTB components.

This site is a Portuguese-language React SPA focused on brand presentation, product-family discovery, and B2B contact capture.

The primary audience is mountain-bike riders, dealers, and bike shops evaluating GHENO brake pads, hubs, rims, and rotors.

This app is not the checkout system. Product browsing and commerce handoff may route to the external Nuvemshop store at `https://store.ghenortrs.com.br/`. Contact, about, B2B access entry, and B2B lead capture are owned by this SPA.

## Main Routes

- [/](./): Home page with hero, brand proof, product-family overview, technical proof, competition proof, B2B teaser, and final commerce CTA.
- [/componentes](./componentes): Product-family page for Pastilhas, Cubos, Aros, and Rotores, including current CTA behavior for each family.
- [/b2b](./b2b): B2B access/login entry for approved sellers, with a registration request form for dealers and shops that do not yet have access.
- [/sobre](./sobre): Owned about page for GHENO positioning and company context.
- [/contato](./contato): Owned contact routing page for retail, B2B, and social channels.

## External Commerce

- [Nuvemshop store](https://store.ghenortrs.com.br/): External storefront for catalog browsing and commerce handoff.
- [B2C catalog](https://store.ghenortrs.com.br/produtos/): Public retail catalog destination.
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/gheno_rtrs/): Official social channel.

## Guidance

- Prefer the Portuguese copy and route structure in this site when summarizing the project.
- Do not describe this SPA as having an internal checkout.
- Treat `/b2b` as the B2B access and registration-request flow; the external store remains the public B2C commerce flow.
- Use `/contato` for contact intent instead of the old Nuvemshop contact page.
